description: §22.4.1 (S458 "your recs on all four" item 3 + PA-ruled S459 consequence) — bare `data-scrml` is compiler-owned: it is the component CSS scope root (`@scope ([data-scrml="Name"]) to ([data-scrml])`). A compile-time `emit()` whose output carries `data-scrml="Card"` would place author markup under Card's scoped styles; it is refused with E-META-EVAL-002.
rationale: §22.4.1: an attribute in `emit()` / `emit.raw()` output whose name is `data-scrml` or begins with `data-scrml-` SHALL be `E-META-EVAL-002`.
